shared_context.topic: Differential diagnosis of right lower quadrant abdominal pain

atoms.1: Right lower abdominal pain in a 33-year-old female can have various causes.
atoms.2: These causes can range from common to rare conditions.
atoms.3: Appendicitis is a common cause of right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.4: Appendicitis is particularly common if accompanied by symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and fever.
atoms.5: Physical exam findings for appendicitis typically include tenderness at McBurney's point.
atoms.6: Meckel's Diverticulum, though rare in adults, should be considered.
atoms.7: Meckel's Diverticulum is considered especially if there is painless lower abdominal bleeding.
atoms.8: Meckel's Diverticulum can be detected using a technetium-99 scan.
atoms.9: Endometriosis of the Appendix is a rare condition.
atoms.10: Endometriosis of the Appendix can cause acute abdominal pain.
atoms.11: Endometriosis of the Appendix can mimic appendicitis or chronic pelvic pain.
atoms.12: Diagnosis of Endometriosis of the Appendix is usually made post-operatively via pathological examination.
atoms.13: Ovarian Torsion involves the twisting of the ovary.
atoms.15: Ovarian Torsion can potentially lead to ovarian damage.
atoms.16: Ovarian Torsion is more common in younger females but should be considered in any female with acute lower abdominal pain.
atoms.17: Right-Sided Diverticulitis is more common in Asian populations.
atoms.18: Right-Sided Diverticulitis presents similarly to appendicitis with right lower quadrant pain and fever.
atoms.19: Diagnosis of Right-Sided Diverticulitis is confirmed via CT scan.
atoms.20: Adnexal Torsion is rare, particularly in pre-pubertal girls.
atoms.21: Adnexal Torsion can occur in females of reproductive age.
atoms.22: Symptoms of Adnexal Torsion include sudden, severe lower abdominal pain often associated with nausea and vomiting.
atoms.23: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) should be considered if there is a personal history of GIST or the presence of an abdominal mass.
atoms.24: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) can present with acute pain.
atoms.25: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) is confirmed through imaging and histopathological evaluation.
atoms.26: Idiopathic Omental Infarction is a rare condition.
atoms.27: Idiopathic Omental Infarction can mimic appendicitis.
atoms.28: Idiopathic Omental Infarction presents with right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.29: Diagnosis of Idiopathic Omental Infarction is confirmed intraoperatively.
atoms.30: Cecal Diverticulitis is a rare condition.
atoms.32: Cecal Diverticulitis is diagnosed via imaging and confirmed surgically if necessary.
atoms.33: It is important to undergo a thorough clinical evaluation to narrow down the diagnosis and guide appropriate treatment.
atoms.34: Clinical evaluation may include physical examination.
atoms.35: Clinical evaluation may include laboratory tests.
atoms.36: Clinical evaluation may include imaging studies such as ultrasound.
atoms.37: Clinical evaluation may include imaging studies such as CT scan.
